# Pick Path Optimizer: shortest pick routes and order batching for small warehouses

> Free tool for small warehouses, 3PLs and online sellers: paste SKU locations (SKU, aisle, bay) and a day of orders, and get carts of orders, a pick list per cart in walking order on the provably shortest route through parallel aisles (Ratliff-Rosenthal dynamic programme), and the walking, hours and wages saved against one order per trip on an S-shape route. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/pick-path-optimizer/): layout, SKU locations, orders, cart size; returns a comparison of six picking options, pick lists with route maps, and a CSV.

## How to use the engine

- `route.mjs` exports `optimalRoute(points, layout)` (exact), `sShapeRoute`, `largestGapRoute`, `returnRoute` and `distance`. Points are `{x, y}` in feet, y measured from the front cross aisle; layout is `{aisleXs, aisleLength, depotX, backAisle}`.
- `calc.mjs` exports `parseLocations`, `parseOrders`, `comparePolicies`, `optimiseBatches`, `pickList` and `pickListCsv`.
